sections.label: Section 10 - Application of Medicine and Its Practice to Osteopathy and Its Practice
sections.citation: Section 10 - Application of Medicine and Its Practice to Ost
sections.text: Section 10. The provisions of this chapter with reference to medicine and its practice shall apply to and include osteopathy and its practice, when such construction is not inconsistent with the following section.

sections.label: Section 11 - Prohibition of Certain Acts by Osteopaths
sections.citation: Section 11 - Prohibition of Certain Acts by Osteopaths
sections.text: Section 11. No person now registered as an osteopath under section one or two of chapter five hundred and twenty-six of the acts of nineteen hundred and nine shall prescribe or administer drugs for internal use, perform major operations in surgery, engage in the practice of obstetrics, or hold himself out, by virtue of such registration, as and for other than an osteopath. Violation hereof shall be punished by the penalty provided in section six.
